name: reversal_volatility_tier_high_0_q
rationale: High-vol tier bleeds (-0.22R); tightening the max ATR extension gate should filter overextended, gappy reversals that dominate the high-vol bucket and drag expectancy. WITHDRAWN 2026-07-03: max_extension_atr is a continuation-path gate (pipeline/analyze.py analyze_frames) that never reaches the reversal detector -- sweeping it would produce an identical reversal book and mint a false null on this hunch.

name: reversal_market_trend_bull_1_q
rationale: The bull-trend sample is large (n=288) but only marginally positive; requiring a deeper/longer pullback before a reversal entry should skip shallow bounces and lift expectancy above the CI bound. WITHDRAWN 2026-07-03: min_pullback_bars gates the continuation pullback detector (signals/detect.py), not the reversal path -- a no-op delta that would burn a sweep slot and mint a false null.

name: reversal_score_0_00_0_50_2_q
rationale: Low score bucket (0.00-0.50) is where nearly all reversals live and is barely breakeven; demanding a more extreme oversold read should concentrate entries into genuine capitulation reversals. WITHDRAWN 2026-07-03: oversold_rsi_max only feeds the continuation 'oversold' tag; the reversal detector reads reversal_oversold_rsi_max, and that one is scoring-only (no gate) -- the delta cannot change the reversal book.
